artifacts.summary: Six theorems landed in FormalSystem/Metalogic/Compactness.lean, discharging CompactBase/CompactDense and collecting Base/Dense strong completeness, plus a tree-wide prose sweep and C14 gate wiring.

completion_data.completion_summary: CompactBase, CompactDense, ModelExistenceBase, ModelExistenceDense, StrongCompletenessBase and StrongCompletenessDense are now proved unconditionally in the new FormalSystem/Metalogic/Compactness.lean, by an ultraproduct model-existence construction over the finite sublists of the premise set. All six are sorry-free at exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], and the axiom audit is now a standing C14 gate rather than a one-off observation. Roughly 30 now-false status claims across Lean docstrings, documentation, the paper record and the archived author memo were corrected, collapsing the three-way status taxonomy to two-way.
roadmap_items: ROADMAP.md Phase 1 Leg B (genuine Set Formula strong completeness for Base/Dense) is closed.
